method.defaults: AntController defaults; no state patch or source override
method.nativePheromone: 316x316 Float32; exact bytes retained at selected analyses
method.analysisGrid: 96x96 at normalized node coordinates; raw chemical projection uses production bilinear field.sample
method.supportMap: Full diagnostic sampleSupport map for spatial comparison; production buildSupportedMask values asserted equal on chemical-qualified cells
method.continuity: maximum Jaccard overlap against any component at immediately preceding production analysis; descriptive only

ridgeSelection.algorithm: positive raw-chemical 8-neighbor maxima; plateau ties choose lower row-major index; sort by value descending/index ascending; greedily keep anchors more than 3 cells apart; at most 12

frozenChecks.contactDigestComparison: Unavailable: the frozen packet stores only a 600 s digest. The 120 s event prefix is checked internally between observer OFF/ON, and first-120 s archived group/foot totals are compared.
frozenChecks.note: Projection uses the frozen G runner 96-grid bilinear coordinates; endpoint array comparisons are exact Float32 values.

crossSectionMethod.normal: minor eigenvector of value-weighted covariance within 11x11 raw-chemical projection window; isotropic covariance tie uses +x
crossSectionMethod.values: raw chemical projection, raw compaction, and full diagnostic sampleSupport; no value threshold added

interpretation.implementation: Current production transforms and thresholds are unchanged; the observer exposes their intermediate maps and selector counts.
interpretation.existingEvidence: The 2026-10-08 local-accretion shadow is pre-G and branch-only. Its outcomes are not current-G natural evidence.
interpretation.newMeasurement: Single current-G seed 20261005, one 0-120 s run, with exact observer-off/on parity and a frozen 120 s receipt.
interpretation.artisticInterpretation: Not evaluated; no formation candidate or renderer was tested.
